scope: Only identifiers needed for existing data/installation compatibility and its audits. No UI, README, release-note or new payload branding exceptions.

native/app/AppController.cpp.reason: Read existing profile directories during migration.

native/platform/Platform.cpp.reason: Read existing platform data and clean or redirect owned legacy registry entries.

native/vault/Vault.cpp.reason: Preserve DPAPI entropy so existing encrypted vaults remain readable.

native/packaging/ZENzip.iss.reason: Keep installer upgrade identity and delete obsolete application files and shortcuts.

native/packaging/package.py.reason: Debian package replacement/conflict identifiers for upgrades.

native/tests/platform/platform.cpp.reason: Ownership and legacy-handler migration regression coverage.

native/tools/check-debian-upgrade.py.reason: Download the published historical package and assert obsolete payload removal.

native/tools/check-branding.py.reason: Matcher used only by the branding audit itself.
